2608.22132.title: SSE-Bio: A Structured Self-Evolving Agent with Agentic Retrieval Policy for Multi-Hop Biomedical Reasoning
2608.22132.paper_summary: Biomedical multi-hop question answering (QA) requires models to connect evidence across intermediate entities such as diseases, drugs, proteins, and phenotypes. Existing agents typically rely on static retrieval workflows or coarse-grained prompt rewriting, which can lead to instruction drift when reasoning procedures need to be updated. We propose SSE-Bio, a structured self-evolving agent with an agentic retrieval policy for multi-hop biomedical reasoning. Instead of globally rewriting agent instructions, SSE-Bio maintains a structured state, selectively retrieves knowledge triplets and prior templates through a trainable proxy policy, and improves its reasoning memory through fine-grained template editing. To optimise retrieval decisions, we introduce a proxy-training strategy based on group relative policy optimization, where the proxy is improved through decision-contrastive groups over alternative retrieval choices. Experiments on three biomedical multi-hop QA benchmarks show that SSE-Bio consistently outperforms existing baselines, achieving an improvement of 6.56 absolute points over the strongest self-evolving baseline on BioHopR.
2608.22132.paper_summary_zh: 生物醫學多跳問題回答（QA）要求模型能夠連接疾病、藥物、蛋白質和表型等中介實體之間的證據。現有的代理通常依賴靜態檢索工作流程或粗略的提示重寫，這可能導致在推理過程需要更新時出現指令漂移。我們提出了SSE-Bio，一種具有代理檢索策略的結構化自我演化代理，用於多跳生物醫學推理。SSE-Bio不會全局重寫代理指令，而是維持一個結構化狀態，通過可訓練的代理策略選擇性地檢索知識三元組和先前模板，並通過細粒度模板編輯來改善其推理記憶。為了優化檢索決策，我們引入了一種基於群體相對策略優化的代理訓練策略，其中代理通過對比決策組來改善替代檢索選擇。對三個生物醫學多跳QA基準的實驗表明，SSE-Bio始終超越現有基線，在BioHopR上實現了相對於最強自我演化基線6.56個絕對點的提升。
